countingSemantics: Completd lines are current planned task estimates, not measured Git changes. Added lines include initial estimates and estimate increases; reductions and dropped work are excluded. Tests use recorded terminal summaries for this repository. Token totals come from providers; missing data remains missing. Forecasts are provisional ranges based on recent completion pace, current estimates, scope changes and test stability. Unestimated work uses the median recorded task size when available.
